thread:
maria: Heads-up — seeing ~350 leads in "Inbound Queue" with no owner for >10m. HubSpot enrichment TTL expired and round-robin fallback didn't trigger. Example lead ids: 789, 790, 791. Anyone else seeing this? @sam
sam: on it. can you paste a single lead id (hs id) or raw webhook payload?
maria: sample paste: {"hs_object_id":789,"email":"test+789@acme.com","enrichment_status":"timeout","rr_slot":12}
sam: thanks. initial hypothesis: enrichment service returned 504 and HS workflow evaluated `enrichment_ready==true` before fallback step. patch idea: add explicit `fallback_owner` step and extend enrichment ttl. proposed snippet:
```
workflow:
  - wait_for: enrichment_status in ["ready"]
  - timeout: 10m
  - on_timeout: set owner = "ops-fallback"
```
anika: also check the HS->SF field mapping — if owner isn't set we end up with `OwnerId=null` in SF (causes leads to be unassigned). small fix: map `lead_owner` to `owner_fallback` before pushing.
sam: deploying quick patch to HS workflows now. command I used: `hsctl workflow update --id=247 --set "timeout=15m,timeout_owner=ops-fallback"` — will monitor. deploy-bot: started rollout for hs-workflow-247 (canary 10%)
deploy-bot: canary complete, rolling to 100% :white_check_mark:
sam: patch applied. also added a metric `inbound_unassigned_pct` and alert at 1%/5m. jordan: nice. please add a dashboard tile in Console -> Marketing -> Leadflow.
maria: counts down from ~350 -> 4 in 12m. sending a note to #support to check customer impact. :thumbsup:
anika: opening JIRA MK-189 to track root-cause, and a postmortem draft in Google Drive (link: http://docs/redwood/pm/mk-189) — assigning to @sam and @jordan. can we also backfill owners for the last 500 leads? sam: yes, I'll run a backfill job: `scripts/backfill_owners --since 2024-03-20 --owner ops-fallback` — ETA 30m.
maria: appreciated. let's follow-up in tomorrow's marketing-ops standup with numbers.
